name: eaves
title: Eaves
description: For roofers: every service is a heather-purple Welsh slate with two copper nails, its title in chalk white and its price at the tail, hung in half-bond courses under a lead ridge on an overcast-grey page.

tokens.--font-display: headings, the business name, phone numbers, prices and customer quotes (a transitional serif)
tokens.--font-body: body text, the menu and small capital labels (a humanist sans)
tokens.--text-s: small text: labels, hours, footer, and tables of three columns or more on a phone
tokens.--text-l: slate titles and prices, the standfirst, sub-headings, customer quotes, figures in tables, the business name and the number in the masthead
tokens.--text-xl: section headings, the price on a service page and the number under a page's standfirst
tokens.--tracking: letter spacing of small capital labels
tokens.--color-text: body text, headings, the menu and the phone number
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: standfirst, labels, hours, footer
tokens.--color-accent: links in the text, the keyboard focus ring, the line under the current menu item and the rule beside a quote
tokens.--color-slate: face of the slates and of the service page heading, the mark beside the business name, selected text
tokens.--color-slate-alt: second slate tone, on some slates and on the plain slates that close a course: the halves at its ends and the whole ones after the last service
tokens.--color-chalk: lettering on slate and the focus outline on a slate
tokens.--color-chalk-line: the chalk line ruled above a slate's price and the light edge along a slate's tail
tokens.--color-sheen: light catching the face of a slate
tokens.--color-lap: shadow one course casts on the head of the next, hard at the lap and fading down the slate, and the ring round a nail
tokens.--color-felt: the roof under the slates: the joints between them and the shadow above the gutter
tokens.--color-lead: lead-grey rules: under the masthead, above headings and the footer, table lines, the edges of the call block, battens, ridge and gutter
tokens.--color-panel: the lead sheet behind the call block, code blocks, the top of the ridge roll
tokens.--color-copper: nail heads on slates, the call block, the mark beside the name and the number under a page's standfirst, and list bullets
tokens.--measure: widest a column of text may get, and the width of the text column on wide screens
tokens.--page-width: widest the page may get (masthead, roof, footer)
tokens.--space-1: small gap: under labels, between list items
tokens.--space-2: standard gap: between paragraphs, padding inside a slate
tokens.--space-3: gap between blocks, padding of the call block and the service page heading
tokens.--space-4: gap between sections and between the heading column and the text column
tokens.--slate-min: least height of a slate when slates stand side by side
tokens.--lap: depth of the shadow where courses lap; the ridge roll and the gutter scale with it
tokens.--rule: thickness of the lead rules, the line under the current menu item and the rule beside a quote
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of code, the focus ring and the mark beside the business name
tokens.--focus: thickness of the keyboard focus ring
tokens.--tap: least height of anything meant to be tapped
